interest: Shows SCAP barter of Japanese textiles for cheap Uruguayan linseed oil to save EROA occupation funds.
overview: February 1949 SCAP telegram reports negotiating 5,000 tons of Uruguayan linseed oil for $480/ton (versus $612.87 U.S. market) in exchange for Japanese cotton and rayon, which would conserve EROA funds; SCAP seeks immediate State and Agriculture comment.

subfiles.about: SCAP reports on negotiations to barter Japanese textiles for 5,000 metric tons of Uruguayan linseed oil at $480 per ton and requests immediate comments.
subfiles.summary: Telegram details a proposed barter of 5,000 tons of Uruguayan linseed oil for Japanese cotton and rayon at $480/ton, well below the U.S. $612.87 market rate; the Army raised no objection, and SCAP seeks Washington's immediate comment to proceed.
subfiles.title: Telegram C-67966 from Tokyo (SCAP) to Secretary of State regarding Linseed Oil Barter with Uruguay
